name: base-defence
description: Idle tanks answer a hit nearby. Six of the player's tanks stand 22 m from a pylon that an enemy bunker shoots; the idle tanks must come and finish the bunker instead of standing where they were, which is what HomeGuard.gd does. The enemy is a bunker because the AI would march spawned tanks home. The AI player is Very Easy so it does nothing of its own in these ninety seconds.

checks.name: the idle tanks came to the fight
the tanks went back to their post
